mapper.select: SELECT b.board_id, b.title, u.nickname, b.created_at, b.view_count FROM tbl_board b LEFT JOIN tbl_user u ON b.user_no = u.user_no
SELECT b.board_id, b.title, b.content, u.nickname, b.view_count, b.created_at, b.user_no, b.like_count FROM tbl_board b LEFT JOIN tbl_user u ON b.user_no = u.user_no WHERE b.board_id = #{boardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_board(user_no, title, content, view_count, created_at, like_count) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, NOW(), 0)
